dlt_enabled.description: Whether the DLT daemon should be enabled (start automatically).

dlt_connect_to_local_socket.description: If true, the daemon connects to the local DLT socket for logging. Set to false to disable local socket usage.

dlt_local_socket_path.description: Path to the local DLT socket used for communication.

dlt_message_history_size.description: Maximum number of messages kept in the in-memory history buffer.

dlt_log_file_path.description: Directory where DLT log files are written when using file-based logging.

dlt_log_file_size.description: Maximum size (in MB) per log file before rotation.

dlt_log_level.description: Global minimum log level: 0 (fatal) to 7 (verbose). Higher = more detailed logs.

dlt_network_logging_enabled.description: If true, enable DLT logging via network (TCP) to remote ECUs.

dlt_network_logging_port.description: Port used for DLT network logging (standard DLT port is 3490).

dlt_network_logging_interface.description: Network interface to bind to for network logging (empty string = all interfaces).

dlt_ecu_list.description: List of remote ECUs to connect to in client mode (for trace log aggregation).

ip.description: IP address (IPv4 or IPv6) of the remote ECU.

port.description: Port number of the remote ECU’s DLT server.
